scenario: Bubbles sits behind an enormous glossy boardroom table on a high chair, tiny laptop open, a row of blank-faced adults in suits staring at him.
dialogue: Per my last email: I need a nap.
title: When HR says 'hostile work environment' 📉

scenario: Bubbles stands on his chair and points a tiny laser pointer at a slide full of upward-pointing charts, while adults nod too eagerly.
dialogue: Sales are up. Naps are down. Unacceptable.

scenario: Bubbles slowly closes his laptop in the middle of a crowded video-call meeting and stares deadpan into the camera.
dialogue: This could have been an email.

scenario: Bubbles interviews a nervous adult candidate across a desk, holding a sippy cup like a coffee mug, resume in front of him.
dialogue: Where do you see yourself in five years? Preferably not here.

scenario: Bubbles sits across from his giant human manager's desk, arms crossed, sliding a crayon-drawn spreadsheet across the table.
dialogue: I would like a raise. I accept payment in snacks.

scenario: Bubbles in the empty office at 4:59 PM on Friday, packing his tiny briefcase while the clock ticks behind him.
dialogue: I do not take calls after five. I am a baby.
